drivers: Two-step compound growth: 200→300→450, simple arithmetic with round numbers
Distractor 900 (if 50% is misread as doubling or 200×1.5×... errors) and 225 (half of 450) catch some careless solvers
Generous 120 s time limit and 4-option format with 25% guessing floor
Common conceptual slip: applying 50% of the original twice (200+100+100=400, not listed) forces a recheck
